description: The canonical model ladder: a continuous difficulty score selects the cheapest model that fits. Both the Builder (for fix downgrades) and the Reviewer (for every review) consume this. Vendored into consumer repos as .playbook/schemas/model_ladder.v1.json; the agents read it so the ladder has one source of truth and cannot drift. Rungs are ordered cheap -> heavy; a score picks the lowest rung whose maxScore it does not exceed; the last rung is the fail-closed ceiling.
